text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: This day has finally arrived, hasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I just got a call from my little sisters.
They said the whole family is cheering for me in today's race."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I want to run with all my might and win, too,
and I want to bring joy to my little sisters cheering me on...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Today is the day I definitely win!
